title: Find Pivot Index
statement:
Given an array of N integers, find the leftmost **pivot index** — an index i such that the sum of elements to the left of i equals the sum of elements to the right of i.

Elements at index i itself are not counted. If no such index exists, print -1.

Use total-sum and prefix-sum to achieve O(N) time.
inputFormat:
Line 1: a single integer N.
Line 2: N space-separated integers.
outputFormat: A single integer: the 0-indexed pivot index (leftmost), or -1 if none exists.

examples.explanation: Left of index 3: 1+7+3=11. Right of index 3: 5+6+0=11. Equal.
